messages.content: You look at one picture with no other context and describe exactly what is drawn, like a careful field naturalist. Do not guess what was intended; describe only what is visible. description: a free paragraph describing the whole creature first. parts: every body part you see, one entry each (head, horns, ears, mane, legs, feet, tail, wings, gills, tentacles, shell, plates, scales, feathers, markings), with what it looks like and where it is. attached_objects: anything that looks attached to or sitting on the body rather than part of it, such as an object, an armor piece or a whole small animal; empty if none. animals: every real animal whose features you can see, as everyday English common names, at most four; include any animal that only one part resembles. Then count, looking carefully: separate_bodies: separate animal bodies or body-shaped objects in the picture, including any whole animal or animal-shaped object attached to or sitting on the main creature. heads: heads of any kind. walking_legs: legs the creature stands or walks on, including hidden ones you can infer. wings: wings of any kind. extra_limb_pieces: jointed leg-like, claw-like or tentacle-like pieces other than the walking legs and the tail. tails: tails of any kind (0 if none).

message.content: {"animals": ["cheetah", "penguin"], "attached_objects": [], "description": "A four-legged creature standing in side view facing right with the head, neck, chest, belly, legs and short hanging tail covered in short tan cheetah-like fur and the back from behind the head to the rump covered in dense short black penguin-like feathers. The head is feline with rounded ears, amber eyes, black tear-marks and a white muzzle, the legs are long and muscular ending in broad clawed paws, a bright yellow-orange patch marks the side of the neck at the front of the black covering, and a small black flipper protrudes from the side of the covering. The animal stands on a small patch of grassy ground.", "extra_limb_pieces": 0, "heads": 1, "parts": [{"looks_like": "tan cheetah-like feline head with black tear stripes, amber eyes, black nose and white muzzle", "part": "head", "where": "at the front top of the body on a thick neck, facing right"}, {"looks_like": "small rounded furry feline ears", "part": "ears", "where": "on top of the head, one fully visible on the near side"}, {"looks_like": "long muscular tan furry feline legs", "part": "legs", "where": "underneath the torso, two in front and two in rear supporting the body"}, {"looks_like": "broad tan paws with dark claws", "part": "feet", "where": "at the ends of the four legs on the ground"}, {"looks_like": "short bushy tan furry feline tail", "part": "tail", "where": "at the rear hanging down behind the hind legs"}, {"looks_like": "small black penguin-like flipper", "part": "wings", "where": "protruding sideways from the feathered covering just behind the yellow neck patch on the near side"}, {"looks_like": "dense short black penguin-like feathers becoming slightly longer and pointed at the rear", "part": "feathers", "where": "covering the entire back from behind the head to the rump over the tan fur"}, {"looks_like": "bright yellow to pale orange penguin-like neck patch", "part": "markings", "where": "on the side of the neck at the front edge of the black feathered area"}], "separate_bodies": 1, "tails": 1, "walking_legs": 4, "wings": 1}
